question: Under which organization does the Trade and Development Board operate?

options.text: United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)

solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)**__.

**__Key Points__**

 
• The **Trade and Development Board (TDB)** operates under the **United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD).** It is one of the key permanent intergovernmental bodies of UNCTAD.
 
• It was established in **1964**, the same year UNCTAD was formed. The TDB was designed to address issues related to trade, development, and interrelated economic areas.
 
• The **primary role** of the Trade and Development Board is to oversee the implementation of the policies set by the Conference. It also evaluates and reviews the progress in the areas of trade and development globally.
 
• The TDB meets regularly, typically once a year, to discuss and deliberate on key trade and development issues, ensuring that UNCTAD's objectives are met effectively.
